goal: Add bounded, credential-free per-operation GitHub request-cost accounting in scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs transport (runGitHubCommand / ghPaginated), patterned on withReviewRequestBudget. The counter increments per gh call (including retries) and fails closed when a budget is exceeded. Marker, admission, claim, review, preview and lock checks are unchanged. Exactly four focused tests prove exact accounting on success, retry, refused admission and stale mutex.
dispatcher: MiMo parent session for popcre/shared-db issue 3617, non-orchestrator tooling work
prohibited_actions: Do not change database structure or data
Do not change marker, admission, claim, review, preview or exclusive-lock checks
Do not touch issue #3505, issue #3552, or db-claim leases
Do not merge the pull request
assumptions: The live measured preparation that identifies its own API cost and the background-call cost separately remains for a later step; this contract covers only the accounting counter and its four focused tests.
No extra GitHub request is issued to measure cost; the counter rides the existing transport.
stop_conditions: Stop if any required check fails for a reason unrelated to request-cost accounting
Stop if the change would need to touch a file outside allowed_paths
